name: analysis-spec-driven
description: Spec-driven data analysis workflow. One workflow skill (analysis-workflow): frame the question, settle the method one decision at a time, run saved SQL, verify by replay, write a plain-English report with visuals, review, hand over. Evidence is committed as a re-runnable pack. Includes a report-writing skill, a first-time analysis-setup skill, and four read-only sub-agents (replay-verifier, method-reviewer, report-checker, writing-checker). Cortex-only.
